item.title: Draft ministerial ordinance on vocational skills tests for vacuum forming and concrete-block work
item.description: AI summary: The Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare published a draft ministerial ordinance on 2026-11-17 to amend the Enforcement Regulations of the Human Resources Development Promotion Act (Ministry of Labour Ordinance No. 24 of 1969), under Articles 44(1) and 51 of the Human Resources Development Promotion Act (Act No. 64 of 1969). The draft would add Grade 3 vacuum-forming test subjects and scope within the plastic-molding occupation, and a basic-grade test for concrete-block construction work within the block-construction occupation. These additions would support skills assessment under the employment-for-skill-development system; the overview describes the related sector-policy changes as subject to further government approval and plans tests from fiscal 2027. The draft also proposes replacing references to technical intern trainees with foreign nationals under the employment-for-skill-development system in Article 66(4), alongside other adjustments associated with Act No. 60 of 2024 amending immigration and technical-intern-training legislation. The stated comment deadline is 2026-12-17 00:00 JST; promulgation is planned for mid-January 2027, with a proposed effective date of 2027-04-01. item.title: Cabinet approves commencement and implementing orders for urban renaissance amendments
item.description: AI summary: The implementing Cabinet Order specifies urban facilities, including roads, parks and plazas, covered by the new urban renaissance development agreement system; it also defines exemptions from notification requirements for alterations to specified buildings in designated local-character areas. It additionally sets a minimum land-area requirement for residents and others proposing plans to maintain and enhance historic character, although the excerpt gives neither the threshold nor the detailed exemptions. On 2026-11-17, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism announced Cabinet approval of this order amending related Cabinet Orders and a separate commencement order. The latter sets 2026-11-24 as the commencement date, except for certain provisions, of the Act Partially Amending the Act on Special Measures concerning Urban Renaissance and Other Acts (Act No. 23 of 2026), which was promulgated on 2026-05-27. item.title: Draft Cabinet Order and Cabinet Office Ordinances on sustainability disclosure, assurance and startup funding
item.description: AI summary: On November 13, 2026, the Financial Services Agency published proposed amendments to related Cabinet Orders, Cabinet Office Ordinances and other instruments, including a new assurance-procedure ordinance, to implement provisions of the Act Partially Amending the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act and the Payment Services Act (Act No. 64 of 2026), enacted on July 15, 2026; the relevant statutory provisions take effect on April 1, 2027. The proposals would require companies listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market with average market capitalization of at least JPY 500 billion, measured at the preceding five fiscal year-ends, to prepare specified non-financial information under designated standards and obtain assurance from registered providers. They would designate SSBJ standards published by June 11, 2026, and add special procedures for approving extensions of annual securities report filing deadlines. Proposed assurance-provider requirements include minimum capital of JPY 20 million, a quality-control function, engagement personnel with relevant knowledge and at least three years of experience, conflict-of-interest restrictions, and seven-year personnel rotation with a two-year cooling-off period. The proposals also cover assurance reports, disclosure of provider identity and fees, and extraordinary reporting upon a provider change; startup funding is another stated subject, but its detailed provisions are not included in the supplied excerpt. Original title: 令和８年金融商品取引法等改正に係る政令・内閣府令案等（サステナビリティ情報の開示・保証、スタートアップ企業への資金供給の促進関係）について公表しました。 Government Announcement | Financial Services Agency (FSA) | Published 2026-11-14 | First detected 2026-11-17 Monitoring aid only; not legal advice or an official translation.
